raw_text: Confirmed from Male sources: Maldives-China military cooperation agreement signed. Key provisions — joint exercises, Chinese-funded coast guard facility on Marao, technical advisor deployment. Indian military personnel already withdrawn. This effectively ends India's decades-long security partnership with the Maldives. IOR strategic balance shifting rapidly.
clean_text: Maldives-China military agreement confirmed. Joint exercises, Marao facility, Chinese advisors. India's decades-long security partnership with Maldives effectively over.
